warnings: task_input_warnings carried forward: source_discovery_not_yet_disease_generic; extraction_record_model_still_hantavirus_named — verify extraction schema is mapped to Legionnaires' disease fields before ingestion
Legionnaires' disease is a provincially notifiable disease in Ontario under the Health Protection and Promotion Act (HPPA) — official PHU and PHO reports are the authoritative source tier
PHO publishes surveillance data with reporting lags; July 2025 data may not be fully available until August or September 2025 — flag any data as preliminary if sourced before end of reporting cycle
Ontario has 34 local public health units; outbreak reports may originate from individual PHUs rather than centrally from PHO — monitor PHU-level communications
Cooling tower and building water system outbreaks are the dominant transmission pathway in Ontario urban settings — prioritize facility-linked cluster reports
Travel-associated Legionnaires' disease cases reported in Ontario may have been acquired in other provinces or internationally — document acquisition location separately from reporting location
PHAC notifiable disease data for 2025 may not be published within the July 2025 window — use as validation source only
Do not infer case counts from environmental sampling results (e.g., positive cooling tower tests) without explicit human case linkage
News reports may precede official PHU confirmation — treat as provisional until validated against official source
Case fatality for Legionnaires' disease is typically 5–15%; absence of death reports does not confirm zero deaths — note data gap explicitly
